$comment: Every public name a release renamed, reshaped or removed, with the Upgrade page section that explains it. `npx nuxt-backend upgrade` rewrites none of an app's code: the edit is yours. Generated by `pnpm generate` (scripts/agent-guidance.mjs). Do not edit: change the code it reads.

renames.section: The Better Auth client loads on first use, and a failed server call names its function
renames.note: the dependency's range; an app that lists the base module itself moves with it

renames.section: The Better Auth client loads on first use, and a failed server call names its function
renames.note: a forwarding client until the auth client loads: calls ($fetch included) and use* hooks work as before; read $store.atoms or a plugin atom on the loaded client

renames.section: The Better Auth client loads on first use, and a failed server call names its function
renames.note: a failure's message starts with [CONVEX Q(module:fn)], as fetchMutation's and fetchAction's do; read getBackendError(error) rather than compare the message

renames.section: The upload field retries a failure, and prepares a file before it uploads
renames.note: returns retry and bind.retry; a failure ends in error with Try again, a refusal in refused, and the error slot adds refused and retry
`categories` names shared categories (`sexual`, `hate`); the classifier's codes (`S12`) moved to `codes`, beside `scores` and `providers`; `block` and `escalate` take either

renames.section: A production checkout waits for billing to launch, and welcome credits come from the catalog
renames.note: only a sale on a production deployment with no token or no production catalog; every other refusal keeps `not_configured`

renames.section: A production checkout waits for billing to launch, and welcome credits come from the catalog
renames.note: a production deployment with a token whose catalog `billing sync --env production` never wrote; a sandbox one keeps `no_catalog`

renames.section: A production checkout waits for billing to launch, and welcome credits come from the catalog
renames.note: welcome credits on the free plan, granted once per person on the first start, as soon as the reverse trial begins; drop the hand-rolled grant

renames.section: A job step stops its model calls at its timeout
renames.note: a step aborts its model calls at `timeout`, by default 3 minutes or 80% of `stallAfter`; set `timeout` for a longer step, below `stallAfter`

renames.from: access.invites.create with a label per member
renames.section: Members bring friends with a ticket of their own, and the waitlist records the campaign
renames.note: re-export its `api` (`getMemberTicket`, `issueMemberTicket`) and read it with `useMemberTicket()`; drop the table of links the app kept

renames.section: Members bring friends with a ticket of their own, and the waitlist records the campaign
renames.note: the address's `utm_source` and `utm_campaign` follow the source; `campaign: false` records the source alone

renames.section: A job joins on a balance never read
renames.note: a balance never read no longer refuses `not_synced`: the job joins, and its first step reads the balance or fails `insufficient_credits`; a balance read with no credit meter is still refused `not_ready`

renames.section: Report forms send notices, and the legal pages fill your own
renames.note: or `useReportForm(subject)` for a notice (DSA Art. 16) through `sendNotice`, with the fields it requires

renames.section: Browser error reports go through a tunnel on the app's own origin
renames.note: the peer range; an older SDK still reports, straight to the ingest, and the build and `doctor` warn

renames.section: The packaged UI reads its faces, lines and shadows from tokens
renames.note: the outermost element of every packaged component and page; `<AppShell>` marks its own controls, not its root
